paper_cards.title: PointCast: One World Model for Rigid, Articulated, and Deformable Object Manipulation
paper_cards.data: Randomized rigid, cloth, rope, and cabinet simulation plus a real teleoperation dataset.
paper_cards.method: 19.8M diffusion transformer predicts identity-preserving 3D point trajectories conditioned on point history and end-effector motion.
paper_cards.task: Predict object dynamics and support sampling-based MPC across object regimes.
paper_cards.novelty: One mesh-free, topology-agnostic state/pipeline spans rigid, articulated, and deformable dynamics.
paper_cards.evidence: Best on three of four simulation regimes; lowest mean real-data error in four of six categories; four simulated MPC tasks over 64 episodes.

claim_checks.notes: Project page exposes prediction and rollout videos.

paper_cards.limitations: Separate checkpoint per regime; MPC demonstrated mainly in simulation; no unified cross-regime checkpoint.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Reusable point identity, object state, action-conditioned trajectory, and deformable/articulated dynamics fields.

paper_cards.title: AgriGen: Large-Scale Scene Generation Framework for Photorealistic Agricultural Robotics Simulation
paper_cards.data: Procedurally parameterized row-crop, orchard, and vineyard environments.
paper_cards.method: ROS-integrated Isaac Sim generation with crop/layout parameters, photorealistic rendering, physics, and lighting/domain randomization.
paper_cards.task: Generate large, controlled agricultural simulation environments for robot learning and evaluation.
paper_cards.novelty: Packages agricultural morphology and seasonal/lighting variation into a scalable robotics PCG interface.
paper_cards.evidence: Official project shows crop categories, straight/curved layouts, scale variation, and multiple lighting conditions; workshop best applied contribution.

claim_checks.claim: ICRA workshop award and simulator scope

paper_cards.limitations: Code/data/docs are not yet released; no downstream policy benchmark is reported on the page.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Concrete PCG fields for crop type, row geometry, terrain, lighting, physics, and domain randomization.

paper_cards.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
paper_cards.data: OGBench-Cube and five simulation environments; DROID post-training for Franka transfer.
paper_cards.method: Residual latent dynamics plus inverse-dynamics and normalized action-recovery objectives preserve counterfactual action information for MPC.
paper_cards.task: Rank candidate actions and plan closed-loop control with a latent world model.
paper_cards.novelty: Optimizes action discrimination required by MPC rather than factual next-state error alone.
paper_cards.evidence: Hard-start Cube success rises 3.7% to 52.0%; Franka pick-and-place rises 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation.
paper_cards.limitations: Author-reported, relatively narrow real-robot task; auxiliary objectives require matched action labels.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct evidence that world-state representations need counterfactual action separability and planning-aligned diagnostics.

paper_cards.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
paper_cards.data: Policy rollouts with injected actuation bias and joint-encoder offsets across four bimanual/dexterous tasks.
paper_cards.method: A plug-in context encoder compresses rollout observations, proprioception, and actions; AdaLN conditions the policy and ensembles context tokens for iterative correction.
paper_cards.task: Adapt a deployed VLA online to hardware and workstation shifts without continuous recalibration.
paper_cards.novelty: Turns the policy's own rollout history into a latent hardware-shift descriptor for self-correction.
paper_cards.evidence: Recovers over 80% of base performance under hardware shifts and improves transfer to new workstations.
paper_cards.limitations: Shift families are deliberately injected and evaluation covers four precision tasks; broader drift remains open.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful deployment adaptation fields: context window, calibration shift, correction iteration, and recovered success.

paper_cards.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
paper_cards.data: LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world Unitree G1 tasks.
paper_cards.method: Sliding video-action window with staggered noise levels fully denoises imminent actions while retaining partially refined future chunks.
paper_cards.task: Reduce closed-loop WAM replanning latency without discarding future imagination.
paper_cards.novelty: Amortizes joint denoising across replanning cycles through rolling imagination.
paper_cards.evidence: 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup; 98.1% LIBERO, 93.3% RoboTwin 2.0, and 85.0% real G1 average success reported.
paper_cards.limitations: Some comparison videos are marked coming soon; latency excludes warm-up and initialization.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong reference for rolling prediction state, chunk lifecycle, and latency-aware WAM execution.

paper_cards.title: Streaming-WAM: Action-Conditioned World-Action Model for Asynchronous Robot Manipulation
paper_cards.data: LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and two real-robot manipulation tasks.
paper_cards.method: Streaming update conditions future visual tokens on committed-action prefixes while concurrently generating remaining actions.
paper_cards.task: Keep robot execution continuous while maintaining action-aligned future prediction.
paper_cards.novelty: Explicitly routes already scheduled actions into asynchronous WAM prediction.
paper_cards.evidence: 98.35% LIBERO average; 2.93x mean episode-time reduction; real stamp task falls from 90s to 38s; code/models released.
paper_cards.limitations: Real tasks remain narrow; performance depends on stable overlap scheduling and committed-action accuracy.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Defines committed-action prefix and asynchronous prediction/execution interfaces for WAM systems.

paper_cards.title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
paper_cards.data: 7,233.5 hours and 811,969 episodes across 25 domains, including 275.4 hours of EgoLab video.
paper_cards.method: Asymmetric video/action experts with flow matching, cached predictive context, observation-conditioned routing, heterogeneous embodiment interfaces, and tactile/force post-training.
paper_cards.task: Predict physical futures and control heterogeneous robots efficiently, including contact-rich scientific workflows.
paper_cards.novelty: Combines multi-frequency asynchronous prediction, omnimodal control, and science-native task evaluation in an open model family.
paper_cards.evidence: 98.6% LIBERO, 93.12% RoboTwin 2.0-Full, 16.47 Hz model updates, plus 15-stage MOF and five-stage pipetting demos; weights and code released.
paper_cards.limitations: Large training mixture and hardware make reproduction expensive; real science results are author-reported over 15 trials/task.
paper_cards.project_relevance: High-value baseline for asynchronous world/action interfaces, multimodal contact state, and long-horizon lab-task progress.

paper_cards.title: EmbodiedMemory-Bench: Benchmarking Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
paper_cards.data: 2,554 executable episodes across passive observation, dynamic tracking, interaction failure, and experience generalization in AI2-THOR/ProcTHOR.
paper_cards.method: Agents consume prior interaction history, build spatial/event/scene memory, and act on a later task; EMem and EMem-8B provide baselines.
paper_cards.task: Evaluate whether embodied agents retain, update, and use memory in long-horizon tasks.
paper_cards.novelty: Separates four action-relevant memory failure modes using executable episodes rather than static QA alone.
paper_cards.evidence: 46.9 GB official data release, public benchmark format, SR/ERR metrics, and simulator/evaluation interfaces.
paper_cards.limitations: Built on AI2-THOR/ProcTHOR and released under CC BY-NC 4.0; public code notes staged simulator instructions.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct benchmark for persistent world state, interaction-derived facts, and memory-conditioned action.

paper_cards.title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
paper_cards.data: 150 cognitive-science-inspired Blender tasks, 1.5M training samples, and a 300-question exam across six categories.
paper_cards.method: Procedural generators randomize nuisance variables while preserving object-permanence structure; PWM-WROP fine-tunes a 16B continuation world model.
paper_cards.task: Train and evaluate object permanence and solidity in generative video world models.
paper_cards.novelty: Turns core-cognition probes into scalable generators, an open corpus/exam, model answers, weights, and native PyTorch training stack.
paper_cards.evidence: Fourteen video models evaluated; blind Elo ranks PWM-WROP first among continuation models and third overall; all main artifacts released.
paper_cards.limitations: Synthetic tasks may not transfer to natural interactive environments; Elo is human preference rather than direct action utility.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Provides explicit object-persistence/solidity tests and scalable physical-state supervision.

paper_cards.title: RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World?
paper_cards.data: More than 5,000 expert demonstrations with ground-truth parameters and continuous variation over 13 physical attributes.
paper_cards.method: Physics-diverse RoboTwin evaluation varies mass, friction, and joint dynamics within plausible ranges and tests WAM/VLA robustness.
paper_cards.task: Measure and improve manipulation policy robustness to physical-condition shifts.
paper_cards.novelty: Elevates physical parameters to a first-class benchmark axis beyond appearance and scene-layout randomization.
paper_cards.evidence: Primary report finds marked degradation for models that remain effective under visual/layout randomization.
paper_cards.limitations: Technical report currently lacks a dedicated official project/code surface; results remain simulation-centered.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct validator for mass, friction, joint dynamics, condition estimation, and physics-conditioned policy fields.

paper_cards.title: Fysiverse-3D-Vision Technical Report: Generating Executable 3D Worlds from Images through Unified Spatial Reasoning
paper_cards.data: Single images paired with semantic, geometric, layout, and physical-property supervision; precise corpus details require paper consultation.
paper_cards.method: Unified vision-language-geometry Transformer, object-conditioned layout prediction, and collision-aware refinement.
paper_cards.task: Generate editable, executable 3D worlds from a single image.
paper_cards.novelty: Decouples spatial layout reasoning from asset synthesis while jointly learning semantic and metric geometry.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports gains in consistency, layout, rendering, and physical understanding; no official project/code/demo page was found.
paper_cards.limitations: Visual quality and executability cannot be confidently judged from an independent official demo surface.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Potential compiler from images into object transforms, geometry, collision constraints, and editable assets.

paper_cards.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
paper_cards.data: LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-90 skills, robosuite transfer, expert videos, teaching traces, and harness traces.
paper_cards.method: Contact views, editable action rehearsal, imagination-agent critique, in-view correction, and skill-agent retrieval expose a visual action workspace to VLMs.
paper_cards.task: Let general VLMs preview, revise, and execute robot manipulation actions.
paper_cards.novelty: Makes visual action rehearsal the common interface for planning, correction, skill evolution, and student training.
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports 75.6% LIBERO-Pro success and Qwen3.5-9B out-of-domain improvement from 1.7% to 43.3%.

claim_checks.notes: No official project or repository found.

paper_cards.limitations: Marked work in progress; robot executions and rehearsal quality cannot be confidently inspected outside paper figures.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Directly relevant visual workspace, proposal, critique, and corrective-action representation.
